confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of July 2026 tourist pricing; no live listings, menus or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink prices vary widely between beachfront venues and local eateries, and accommodation is least certain at July high-season rates. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the local draft-beer anchor (tourist-venue drinks priced at several times the beer price) because direct knowledge of them is weaker. FX: the value and date come from web-search summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the RBA table directly. The most recent RBA row my searches reached is dated 2026-03-20, which predates the generation date. An October 2026 figure appeared in one summary, but a later search could not confirm it, so treat the FX observation as potentially stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis is Southeast Asian beach-resort pricing, informally benchmarked against Vietnamese coastal tourist cities such as Da Nang and Phu Quoc. Accommodation anchors reflect July high-season demand. No live listings were consulted.
